'''January 2001 Columbus tournament (13 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Columbus, Ohio on 13 January 2001. [[Justin Danenberg]] won it. It is known from David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ columbus-ohio-1-13-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Danenberg]]
